{{Quote|Yes, commander?''"<br />"''We discovered that Jabba the Hutt has also hired bounty hunters to track down his son, and we've followed them to a monastery on the planet Teth.|[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and the commander|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />|audio = MonasteryOnTeth-TCWf.flac}}
This '''[[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force trooper]]''', who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], was tasked with tracking down the kidnapped [[Rotta/Legends|son]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|We feel it's where Jabba's son is, but it's too heavily fortified for us to do anything alone, sir.''"<br />"''Commander, stay out of sight and await further orders.''"<br />"''Will do, sir.|The commander, and Jedi General Mace Windu|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />}}
After [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], was kidnapped by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], this [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force trooper]] commander was sent along with an ARF trooper [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Force lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to track down the kidnapped Hutt. After following hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that were contracted by Jabba, they discovered that the Hutt was sent to a [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr]] [[B'omarr Monastery|monastery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. After contacting [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], the commander told him that the monastery was too heavily fortified for them to do anything alone. Afterward, once Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] fleet entered the [[Teth system/Legends|Teth system]], the ARF Troopers reported to General Skywalker that there were at least two [[Droid/Legends|droid]] battalions protecting the monastery, and that he would not be able to land there.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />

==Equipment==
This trooper wore a lightweight recon [[Armor/Legends|armor]] made of [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] material, equipped with surveillance gear. Their armor was camouflaged to fit the environment of the planet Teth.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars home video releases#Star Wars: The Clone Wars film|DVD]] subtitles, this character is mistakenly identified as [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].
